notes: Real model call (1 ledger attempt). Claude proposed W 96 / depth 30 / base 32 x 9 / pitch 68: edge distance fixed (14 mm >= 13.5) but it raised the housing depth from 20 to 30 mm and estimated <= 170 g; CadQuery measured 208.859 g and rejected it on mass (limit 175 g). The solver decided against the AI.

An earlier take the same evening (1 ledger attempt) had Claude propose W 98 / base 32 x 8 / pitch 70 / crown 6, accepted at 137.957 g; it was re-recorded only because the caption printed the engine as 'default'. Both outcomes are real; this take is published.

In chapter 3 the family switch reset the mass limit to the family default 250 g, so the optimisation ran against 250 g, not 175 g; its lightest feasible housing (145.335 g) meets 175 g as well. The recorder now keeps 175 g.
Local recording: the release is signed with the local Ed25519 key; the hosted site signs with AWS KMS.
